很多玩家以为血月是随机的，其实它有固定周期和明确规则。搞懂周期能规划刷怪路线，搞懂刷新清单能知道什么值得等血月，搞懂做菜窗口能批量做出大成功料理。本篇把这三点一次讲清，顺便纠正一个流传很广的错误数字。

Many players think the Blood Moon is random, but it actually has a fixed cycle and clear rules. Understanding the cycle lets you plan monster-farming routes, understanding the refresh list tells you what is worth waiting for a Blood Moon for, and understanding the cooking window lets you batch-cook critical-success dishes. This guide explains all three points at once, and also corrects a widely repeated wrong number.
⭐ 本篇要点
⭐ Key points of this guide
王国之泪的血月周期是 144 分钟实际游玩时间，约游戏内 6 天；不是旷野之息的 168 分钟/7 天。
The Blood Moon cycle in Tears of the Kingdom is 144 minutes of actual play time, about 6 in-game days — not Breath of the Wild's 168 minutes / 7 days.
计时从时之神殿接到主线“紧闭之门”后开始；开菜单、读图不计时，坐篝火睡觉不能催血月。

Timing starts after accepting the main quest 'The Closed Door' at the Temple of Time; opening menus and loading screens don't count, and sitting by a campfire to sleep cannot hurry a Blood Moon along.
到点时若人在地底、神庙、神殿或城堡内，血月顺延到下一晚。
If you are in the Depths, a Shrine, a temple, or Hyrule Castle when the time comes, the Blood Moon is postponed to the next night.
刷新：被打倒的怪物（含头目）与野外及敌人手中的武器；不刷新：宝箱、呀哈哈、采集物、矿床。
Refreshes: defeated overworld monsters (including overworld bosses) and weapons in the wild and in enemies' hands. Does not refresh: treasure chests, Koroks, gatherables, and ore deposits.
做菜窗口 23:30 至次日 00:15 必大成功；强制血月是利用游戏机制的过载触发，非官方功能。
The cooking window from 23:30 to 00:15 the next day guarantees critical success; a forced Blood Moon is an overload trigger exploiting game mechanics, not an official feature.

常见问题
FAQ
先纠正一个常见错误：王国之泪的血月周期是 144 分钟实际游玩时间，约游戏内 6 天。168 分钟/7 天是旷野之息的旧数，套用到王国之泪会算错时间。如果你按 168 分钟等血月，会发现血月总是“提前”来——不是游戏乱了，是周期本来就更短。

First, a common error to correct: the Blood Moon cycle in Tears of the Kingdom is 144 minutes of actual play time, about 6 in-game days. 168 minutes / 7 days is the old Breath of the Wild number, and applying it to Tears of the Kingdom will miscalculate the timing. If you wait for a Blood Moon on a 168-minute schedule, you'll find the Blood Moon always seems to come 'early' — the game isn't acting up, the cycle is simply shorter.
血月计时从时之神殿接到主线“紧闭之门”后开始。之后只有实际游玩时间算数：开菜单、读图加载都不计时，坐在篝火前睡觉也不能催出血月。想等血月就去正常游玩、做任务、探索，时间到了自然会来；挂机睡觉是等不到的。

Blood Moon timing starts after accepting the main quest 'The Closed Door' at the Temple of Time. After that, only actual play time counts: opening menus and loading screens don't count, and sitting by a campfire to sleep cannot bring on a Blood Moon. If you want to wait for a Blood Moon, just play normally — do quests and explore — and it will come when the time arrives; idling and sleeping won't get you one.
血月过场：到点时全图怪物与武器刷新（游戏实机截图）
Blood Moon cutscene: when the time comes, monsters and weapons across the whole map refresh (in-game screenshot)
到点时如果林克在地底、神庙、神殿或城堡内，血月不会在里面触发，而是顺延到下一晚。规划刷怪路线时要注意：想在当晚等血月，就别在到点前钻进神庙或地底，否则要多等一晚。

If Link is in the Depths, a Shrine, a temple, or Hyrule Castle when the time comes, the Blood Moon won't trigger inside — it is postponed to the next night. When planning a monster-farming route, note: if you want to wait for the Blood Moon that night, don't duck into a Shrine or the Depths just before the time comes, or you'll have to wait an extra night.

这张清单决定了血月的用途：刷怪素材、刷武器、刷头目掉落，血月是最好的闹钟；但想靠血月刷宝箱、呀哈哈或矿石，是刷不出来的，别白等。

This list determines what the Blood Moon is for: for monster materials, weapons, and boss drops, the Blood Moon is the best alarm clock; but if you hope to farm treasure chests, Koroks, or ores from a Blood Moon, they won't respawn — don't wait in vain.
血月夜 23:30 至次日 00:15 做料理必定大成功，批量做高级料理就卡这个窗口，详见本站料理机制全解。

Cooking between 23:30 on a Blood Moon night and 00:15 the next day guarantees critical success, so batch-cook high-end dishes inside this window — see this site's Cooking Mechanics Explained for details.
另外有一种强制血月的方法：用多连弓加蛋白石箭射可破坏岩壁制造过载触发，这属于利用游戏机制、非官方功能，且 1.0.0 版本不可用，普通玩家按正常周期等血月就够了，不用专门去学。

There is also a forced Blood Moon method: using a multi-shot bow with Opal arrows to shoot destructible rock walls to create an overload trigger. This exploits game mechanics, is not an official feature, and does not work in version 1.0.0; ordinary players only need to wait for Blood Moons on the normal cycle and don't need to learn it.
